hypotheses.S1_performance_replicates: Across four seeds, hard-route geometric-mean KL has coefficient of variation at most 10%.
hypotheses.S2_every_seed_beats_global32: Every seed reduces mean exact KL by at least 20% versus global rank 32 on every corpus.
hypotheses.S3_expert_subspaces_recur: After permutation alignment, every replicate has mean expert-subspace cosine at least 0.75 to the reference.
hypotheses.S4_routes_recur_in_distribution: After expert alignment, every replicate agrees with the reference hard route on at least 70% of FineWeb sites.
hypotheses.S5_routes_recur_ood: After expert alignment, every replicate agrees with the reference route on at least 60% of WikiText and TinyStories sites.
hypotheses.S6_function_more_stable_than_coordinates: If expert or route stability fails, performance stability still passes, distinguishing a canonical function from a canonical decomposition.
